description: Creates a new custom field on an existing Salesforce object. The field API name must end with '__c'. Supports all field types: Text, Number, Picklist, Lookup, etc.

defaultValue.description: Default value for the field. Use true/false for Checkbox fields.

deleteConstraint.description: Delete behaviour for Lookup fields: 'Cascade', 'Restrict', or 'SetNull'

externalId.description: Whether this field is an external ID

fieldName.description: API name of the field, e.g. 'Status__c'

label.description: Display label for the field, e.g. 'Status'

length.description: Max length. Text/TextArea: 1–255 (default 255). LongTextArea/Html (Text Area Long / Rich Text Area): 256–131072 (default 32768).

objectName.description: API name of the parent object, e.g. 'Account' or 'Invoice__c'

default.description: Whether this is the default value

fullName.description: API name for the picklist value (e.g. 'New')

isActive.description: Whether the value is active (default true)

restricted.description: If true, only values in the list are allowed

picklistValues.description: Picklist values. Either a plain list (['Draft','Open']) or the full { restricted, sorted, values } object. Required for Picklist / MultiselectPicklist types.

referenceTo.description: Target object API name for Lookup/MasterDetail, e.g. 'Account'

relationshipLabel.description: Label for the relationship on the related object

relationshipName.description: API name for the relationship (no spaces)

required.description: Whether the field is required on page layouts

unique.description: Whether values must be unique (Text, Number, Email)

visibleLines.description: Visible lines. Required for LongTextArea and Html (Text Area Long / Rich Text Area) — default 10. Also used for MultiselectPicklist.

name: sf_create_custom_field
title: Create Salesforce Custom Field
